meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 装上后,说 triage 之类的词,Claude 就会读取仓库所有开放的 issue 和 PR,逐条分析(分问答、Bug、功能请求等),并把带 GitHub 代码链接证据的报告写入 /tmp 下的文件夹。它只读不改,绝不在 GitHub 上评论、合并或关闭任何内容。
howto.when: 当你说出 'triage'、'triage issues'、'triage PRs' 等触发词时触发。

say.text: 帮我 triage 一下所有开放的 issues
say.note: Claude 会逐条分析并写报告到 /tmp。
生成 PR 分析报告,不修改 GitHub。

howto.what_en: Claude reads all open issues/PRs, analyzes each, and writes reports with GitHub permalink evidence to /tmp. It never comments, merges, closes, or labels anything on GitHub — reports only.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', etc.

say_en.text: Triage all open issues for me.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes each and writes reports to /tmp.

say_en.text: Triage PRs and see if there are problems.
say_en.note: Generates PR reports without changing GitHub.
Ensures it only reports and makes no changes.
